notes: Elspeth's Smite, printed: 'deals 3 damage to target attacking or blocking creature. If that creature would die this turn, exile it instead.' Seat 0 attacks with a 3/3 and a second 3/3. After attackers are declared, seat 1 (with a Plains) casts Smite at the first: 3 damage kills it, so it is exiled instead (never in the graveyard). The second attacker is not targeted: it is unharmed and its 3 combat damage reaches seat 1.
